title: SetLayerMaterial Command
description: Assign a RenderMaterial to a layer and set objects on that layer to MaterialFromLayer (By Layer). Creates the material from a preset, reuses material_name, or builds a matte material from diffuse_rgb + name. Creates the layer if missing.

layer_name.description: Target layer (e.g. A-WALL, A-FLOR). Case-insensitive. Created if missing.

preset.description: Matte architectural preset. plaster=M-PLASTER, concrete=M-CONCRETE, clay=M-CLAY, wood=M-WOOD, white=M-WHITE.

material_name.description: Existing RenderMaterial name to reuse. Fails if missing — pass preset or diffuse_rgb + name to create.

name.description: Name for a new matte material when using diffuse_rgb.

diffuse_rgb.description: Diffuse RGB 0–255 for a custom matte material. Requires name.

ensure_objects_from_layer.description: If true, all objects on the layer get MaterialSource = MaterialFromLayer. Default true.
